description: This script manages and verifies the inventory of web search provider boundaries within a project. It scans specific directories for relevant files, extracts provider registration information, and compares the current codebase against a baseline inventory to identify unauthorized or unexpected modifications. The script defines functions for collecting inventory data, reading baseline expectations, and reporting differences, focusing on maintaining clear boundaries and integration points for web search providers in the project.

methods.name: collectWebSearchProviderBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Asynchronously scans project directories, reads relevant files, and compiles an inventory of web search provider boundary entries, caching results for subsequent calls.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads and parses the baseline JSON inventory file, returning an empty array if the file does not exist.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Computes the differences between the expected baseline inventory and the actual inventory collected from the codebase.

methods.name: runWebSearchProviderBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Executes the inventory check process, comparing current state with baseline, with configurable arguments and IO handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for script execution; performs the boundary check and manages process exit codes.
